faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT Delhi) for filling vacant positions under advertisement number 33/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post announced in this notification is Deputy Administrative Officer, specifically focusing on placement and administrative responsibilities within the institution.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Deputy Administrative Officer position under the OBC category on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Deputy Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Level-8 (Rs. 47600 – Rs. 151100) in accordance with the 7th Central Pay Commission guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in the relevant domain with a good academic record (minimum 55% marks) or equivalent along with relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the start date for submitting online applications?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 25 September 2026, allowing eligible candidates to submit their forms through the portal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The final date to submit the online application form is 10 October 2026. Applicants should complete submissions well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: General and other unreserved category candidates are required to pay an application fee of INR 590 through the online payment gateway.

faq.question: Q9. Are reserved categories or women exempted from application fees?
faq.answer: Yes, SC, ST, PwD, women candidates, and internal candidates including allied staff are completely exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply online for this job opening?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can submit their applications online by visiting the official recruitment portal link provided on the official IIIT Delhi website.
